reason: Not closed: no single tier-A source performs an advisor-facing reliability audit of S2 N prescriptions using hyperspectral as a reference. But the problem is not unexplored: Crema et al. 2019 already studied soil variability's effect on S2 maize N assessment in Italy (EU), Fabbri et al. 2021 already questioned whether NDVI is a valid N-management indicator, and Yilmaz et al. 2026 already fuses EnMAP/PRISMA hyperspectral with S2 in agriculture. TYPE_B: the delta must be the audit-not-estimate framing and a measurable flagging accuracy, not the novelty of pairing hyperspectral with S2 at all.

prior_art.title: Interaction between soil variability and maize nitrogen status assessment from Sentinel-2
prior_art.why: Same problem framing (soil variability confounding S2-based N assessment) studied in Italy/EU, but statistically characterizes the interaction rather than building a per-scene hyperspectral audit/flagging tool for advisors; no senescence axis; abstract paywalled.

prior_art.title: Is normalized difference vegetation index a valid indicator for nitrogen fertilization management?
prior_art.why: Same output-space concern (is the S2-style index trustworthy for N management decisions) but no hyperspectral reference sensor, no soil-brightness/senescence decomposition, and no operational audit mechanism proposed.

prior_art.title: Fusion of EnMAP/PRISMA hyperspectral and Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery for estimating crop traits
prior_art.why: Same sensor combination (EnMAP/PRISMA + Sentinel-2) in the same crop domain, but purpose is fusing them to directly improve estimation of 18 wheat biophysical/biochemical traits via PLSR, not to audit or flag when an existing S2-derived prescription is unreliable.

type_b_fields.measurable_axis: % of field zones correctly flagged as N-index-unreliable (soil-brightness or senescence driven) vs Crema's aggregate soil-variance correlation
type_b_fields.attributable_to: per-scene EnMAP/PRISMA spectral unmixing used as an occasional audit reference, vs a statistical soil-variability correction applied without a hyperspectral check

nearest_neighbours_do_not: None of the three neighbours produce an advisor-facing reliability flag: Crema (2019) only statistically correlates soil variance with S2 N-assessment error; Fabbri (2021) questions NDVI validity generically with no reference sensor; Yilmaz (2026) fuses EnMAP/PRISMA+S2 to improve direct trait estimates, not to detect when an existing S2 prescription should be distrusted.
